title: Rampage
build: Activision's European disk of 1987 (PAL), as a G64 bit image (C64 Preservation Project, verified dump)

credits.role: design of the arcade game (Bally Midway, 1986)

credits.by: M. Archer, D. Jolliff, M. Jones, and D. Wainwright of Catalyst Coders
credits.role: Commodore 64 conversion, as the second loading picture credits them

tools.host: Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, no display (cloud container)

accuracy.note: 60 of the 832 hand-written comments and 20 of the 290 a script wrote from templates, checked by a fresh agent against the code; both wrong ones were wrong in a detail

exclude: the sprite shapes of the first monster, drawn at run time by compose_0; the bytes PART7 loads here are cleared by game_start
the first of the two screens the game draws into, by turns
the sprite shapes of the other two monsters and the blank sprite, drawn at run time, and the processor's vectors at $FFFA-$FFFF, which game_start writes; nothing is loaded here
the loader's last stage at the hand-over; in play the three monsters' picture buffers ($CCA0-$CFFF), filled by build_monster_frame
include: 64 sprite shapes kept in the RAM under the I/O area, where only the video chip reads them
